name: talking-head-promo
description: Turn spoken creator videos into polished stories with timed captions, motion graphics, product demos and verified exports.

interface.shortDescription: Captions, motion graphics and pacing for spoken videos.
interface.longDescription: Turn a spoken video into a polished story with timed captions, motion graphics, selective product demos and verified exports. Includes dependency guidance, encrypted local key setup, resumable transcription and reusable HyperFrames scenes. Requires Python, Node.js 22+, FFmpeg and HyperFrames. Cloud transcription requires authorized audio upload and may incur fees.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my spoken video into a polished story with timed captions, motion graphics and a verified export.
